summary.text: Beryl Piccolantonio (Beryl Brown Piccolantonio) is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who has represented District 4 since January 10, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney and former Gahanna school board president, she is the ranking member of the Workforce and Higher Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Beryl Brown Piccolantonio was born in Ohio and earned a B.A. in psychology from Ohio Dominican University in 1999 and a J.D. from The Ohio State University in 2006, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney, and she was elected three times to the Gahanna-Jefferson City School District board and served as board president for eight years.
Ballotpedia lists her school board service as running from 2016 to 2024.
Brown Piccolantonio was appointed to the Ohio House of Representatives to replace Mary Lightbody (D) and assumed office on January 10, 2024.

In the 2025-2026 session she serves on the Children and Human Services, House Education, House Finance and House Rules and Reference committees and is the ranking member of the Workforce and Higher Education Committee.
